facts.value: The fees are the sole responsibility of the student for the duration of their time at the University.
Fees that are not paid within the academic year will result in an automatic block for the student on the system.
The University gives a 60-day grace period after which the student is expected to make payment.
A late fee fine of €200 will apply where students fail to pay fees by the specified due date.
The responsibility for further external arrangements regarding fee payments lies with the student and not the University, so no invoices can be generated for the company.
The cost of international workshops/study tours must be borne by the students.
